subject: Fix TLS infinite busy loop when write/read handlers are removed (#3510)
reason: The change is confined to src/tls.c (updateSSLEvent and tlsHandleEvent), code compiled only with BUILD_TLS and executed only for TLS-type connections. The fuzzer has no TLS capability: no installed component speaks TLS or provisions certificates, every client connection (workloads, compared-sequence private servers, tools) is plain TCP or unix socket, and the deployment provider rejects tls-port in any config, so no server the fuzzer starts can open a TLS listener and no replication link can be TLS.
